title: Security Deposit Account Carpet Life Reduction for Animals in the Home
content:
**Standard.** An animal in the home shortens the carpet life used to depreciate a Security Deposit Account carpet replacement charge:

- **6 months** when a dog was registered on the lease, whether as a pet or as an assistance animal;
- **3 months** when a cat was registered and no dog was;
- **nothing** when neither was.

The carpet life is reduced by these months before the carpet's remaining share is measured against it.

**Records read.** The species of every animal registered on the lease in the Pet Addendum records, the Assistance Animal Accommodation included.

## Combinations

| Dog registered (pet or assistance animal) | Cat registered | Months taken off the carpet life |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | 6 |
| yes | no | 6 |
| no | yes | 3 |
| no | no | 0 |

## Hypothetical cases

- A carpet life of 60 months, with a dog registered as an assistance animal: the carpet life becomes 54 months.
- A carpet life of 60 months, with two cats registered and no dog: the carpet life becomes 57 months.
- Only a caged bird registered: nothing is taken off.
